professionalSummary.text: Maintains CI build infrastructure and remote caching for a monorepo of approximately four million lines of code at Vantor Labs since January 2020.
professionalSummary.witness: Platform engineer at Vantor Labs (code-search software), January 2020 to present, maintaining the CI build infrastructure and remote cache for a monorepo of about four million lines.

professionalSummary.text: Built a Go command-line tool enabling engineers to reproduce CI failures locally with identical container images and environment variables as the pipeline.
professionalSummary.witness: Built a Go command-line tool that lets engineers reproduce CI failures locally with the same container image and environment variables as the pipeline.

professionalSummary.text: Published weekly build-time reports including median and 90th-percentile CI duration, cache hit rate, and quarantined test lists to engineering leadership.
professionalSummary.witness: Published a weekly build-time report (median and 90th-percentile CI duration, cache hit rate) to the engineering leadership channel.

professionalSummary.text: Quarantined intermittent failing tests, filed tickets to owning teams, and restored tests after fixes were validated by teams.
professionalSummary.witness: Quarantined tests that failed intermittently three times in a week, filed tickets to the teams that own them and returned each test to the main suite once its owning team had fixed and re-run it twenty times without a failure.

professionalSummary.text: Added a troubleshooting page for remote cache issues to the team wiki, covering cache misses after base-image changes and safe cache clearing procedures.
professionalSummary.witness: Added a troubleshooting page for the remote cache to the team wiki, covering cache misses after base-image changes and how to clear a poisoned cache entry safely.
